$comment: Lamplit scene and book material, from mockup E. Keys are fixed by docs/adr/0001-flipbook-engine.md. Material colours are sRGB inputs the engine linearizes (pow 2.2). light.color and ambient are linear HDR. background is the output-referred clear colour. light.type is point (lamp with a pool) or directional (window light, which uses direction instead of position and poolCenter). vignette is the corner darkening, 0 to 1. material.paper fills the letterbox band around a scan; material.desk is the procedural wood the book rests on.
